_doc: Deliberate slowdowns a PR may let through with the bench-accepted label. Each row is named exactly, capped by max_ratio, and explained. Remove a row once it is fast again. See docs/BENCHMARKS.md.

accepted.reason: Per-resample Philox4x32-10 streams (Round 9, W4b): the bootstrap SE is identical on any thread count and bit-identical between C++ and Rust. Costs about 1.4-1.5x the old xoshiro stream; vectorising it is follow-up work.
Same per-resample Philox streams as the main-API row.
FX MC VaR moved to the same per-resample Philox streams (Round 18): thread-count determinism and C++/Rust parity, as for equity.
